#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""The pipeline advances only after the next stage's thread id is stored."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

TOP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(TOP / 'tools'))
import stage_handoff

TS = '2026-10-24T19:20:00Z'


class StageHandoff(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.tmp.name) / 'pipeline.json'

    def ledger(self):
        return json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

    def test_stage_order_and_default_ledger(self):
        self.assertEqual(stage_handoff.STAGES,
                         ('Audit', 'Implement', 'Test', 'Validate', 'Merge', 'Publish'))
        self.assertEqual(stage_handoff.DEFAULT_LEDGER, TOP / 'cloud-handoff' / 'pipeline.json')

    def test_advance_waits_for_a_stored_thread_id(self):
        stage_handoff.init(self.path)
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'thread id is recorded'):
            stage_handoff.advance(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)

        stage_handoff.record_thread(self.path, 'Audit', 'thread-audit', TS)
        recorded = self.ledger()
        self.assertIsNone(recorded['current'])
        self.assertEqual(recorded['transitions'], [{
            'stage': 'Audit',
            'thread_id': 'thread-audit',
            'timestamp': TS,
            'status': 'recorded',
            'kind': 'thread',
        }])

        stage_handoff.advance(self.path)
        active = self.ledger()
        self.assertEqual(active['current'], 'Audit')
        self.assertEqual(active['transitions'][0]['status'], 'active')
        self.assertEqual(active['transitions'][0]['thread_id'], 'thread-audit')

    def test_missing_or_subagent_thread_does_not_advance(self):
        stage_handoff.init(self.path)
        state = self.ledger()
        state['transitions'].append({
            'stage': 'Audit',
            'thread_id': None,
            'timestamp': TS,
            'status': 'recorded',
            'kind': 'thread',
        })
        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'thread id is recorded'):
            stage_handoff.advance(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)

        state['transitions'][0]['thread_id'] = 'sub-1'
        state['transitions'][0]['kind'] = 'subagent'
        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'thread id is recorded'):
            stage_handoff.advance(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_rejected_record_does_not_change_the_ledger(self):
        stage_handoff.init(self.path)
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'out of order'):
            stage_handoff.record_thread(self.path, 'Test', 'thread-test', TS)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'thread id required'):
            stage_handoff.record_thread(self.path, 'Audit', ' ', TS)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'timestamp'):
            stage_handoff.record_thread(self.path, 'Audit', 'thread-audit', 'yesterday')
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_each_stage_is_stored_before_it_becomes_current(self):
        stage_handoff.init(self.path)
        previous = None
        for index, stage in enumerate(stage_handoff.STAGES):
            stamp = f'2026-10-24T19:2{index}:00Z'
            thread = f'thread-{stage}'
            stage_handoff.record_thread(self.path, stage, thread, stamp)
            midpoint = self.ledger()
            self.assertEqual(midpoint['current'], previous)
            self.assertEqual(midpoint['transitions'][-1]['thread_id'], thread)
            self.assertEqual(midpoint['transitions'][-1]['status'], 'recorded')
            stage_handoff.advance(self.path)
            self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['current'], stage)
            self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['transitions'][-1]['status'], 'active')
            previous = stage
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'complete'):
            stage_handoff.advance(self.path)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'complete'):
            stage_handoff.record_thread(self.path, 'Audit', 'thread-again', TS)
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['current'], 'Publish')

    def test_one_thread_id_cannot_walk_every_stage(self):
        stage_handoff.init(self.path)
        shared = 'thread-shared'
        stage_handoff.handoff(self.path, 'Audit', shared, TS)
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['current'], 'Audit')
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'its own thread'):
            stage_handoff.handoff(self.path, 'Implement', shared, '2026-10-24T19:21:00Z')
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)
        for index, stage in enumerate(stage_handoff.STAGES[2:], start=2):
            with self.assertRaises(stage_handoff.HandoffError):
                stage_handoff.handoff(self.path, stage, shared, f'2026-10-24T19:2{index}:00Z')
            self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['current'], 'Audit')
        self.assertNotEqual(self.ledger()['current'], 'Publish')

        state = self.ledger()
        state['transitions'].append({
            'stage': 'Implement',
            'thread_id': shared,
            'timestamp': TS,
            'status': 'recorded',
            'kind': 'thread',
        })
        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        reused = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'its own thread'):
            stage_handoff.advance(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), reused)
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['current'], 'Audit')

        distinct = Path(self.tmp.name) / 'distinct.json'
        stage_handoff.init(distinct)
        for index, stage in enumerate(stage_handoff.STAGES):
            stage_handoff.handoff(distinct, stage, f'thread-{index}', f'2026-10-24T19:3{index}:00Z')
        done = json.loads(distinct.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        self.assertEqual(done['current'], 'Publish')
        self.assertEqual([item['thread_id'] for item in done['transitions']],
                         [f'thread-{index}' for index in range(len(stage_handoff.STAGES))])

    def test_handoff_persists_the_thread_before_advance_saves(self):
        stage_handoff.init(self.path)
        seen = []
        real_save = stage_handoff.save

        def spy(path, state):
            seen.append((state['current'], [item['thread_id'] for item in state['transitions']]))
            real_save(path, state)

        original = stage_handoff.save
        stage_handoff.save = spy
        try:
            stage_handoff.handoff(self.path, 'Audit', 'thread-audit', TS)
        finally:
            stage_handoff.save = original
        self.assertEqual(seen[0], (None, ['thread-audit']))
        self.assertEqual(seen[1][0], 'Audit')
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['current'], 'Audit')

    def test_subagents_only_help_the_running_stage(self):
        stage_handoff.init(self.path)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'already running'):
            stage_handoff.note_helper(self.path, 'Audit', 'sub-1', TS)
        stage_handoff.handoff(self.path, 'Audit', 'thread-audit', TS)
        stage_handoff.note_helper(self.path, 'Audit', 'sub-1', TS)
        state = self.ledger()
        self.assertEqual(state['current'], 'Audit')
        self.assertEqual(state['helpers'], [{
            'stage': 'Audit',
            'subagent_id': 'sub-1',
            'timestamp': TS,
            'status': 'in-stage',
        }])
        self.assertEqual(len(state['transitions']), 1)
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'thread id is recorded'):
            stage_handoff.advance(self.path)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'not a subagent'):
            stage_handoff.record_thread(self.path, 'Implement', 'sub-1', TS)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'already running'):
            stage_handoff.note_helper(self.path, 'Implement', 'sub-2', TS)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(stage_handoff.HandoffError, 'not a subagent'):
            stage_handoff.note_helper(self.path, 'Audit', 'thread-audit', TS)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_cli_consults_the_ledger(self):
        script = TOP / 'tools' / 'stage_handoff.py'

        def run(*args):
            return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), '--ledger', str(self.path), *args],
                                  text=True, capture_output=True)

        created = run('init')
        self.assertEqual(created.returncode, 0, created.stderr)
        refused = run('advance')
        self.assertEqual(refused.returncode, 1, refused.stdout)
        self.assertIn('thread id is recorded', refused.stderr)
        self.assertIsNone(self.ledger()['current'])
        delivered = run('handoff', '--stage', 'Audit', '--thread-id', 'bc-audit', '--timestamp', TS)
        self.assertEqual(delivered.returncode, 0, delivered.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['current'], 'Audit')
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['transitions'][0]['thread_id'], 'bc-audit')
        skipped = run('handoff', '--stage', 'Validate', '--thread-id', 'bc-validate', '--timestamp', TS)
        self.assertEqual(skipped.returncode, 1, skipped.stdout)
        self.assertIn('out of order', skipped.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.ledger()['current'], 'Audit')
        self.assertEqual([item['stage'] for item in self.ledger()['transitions']], ['Audit'])
        shown = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), 'show', '--ledger', str(self.path)],
                               text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(shown.returncode, 0, shown.stderr)
        self.assertIn('bc-audit', shown.stdout)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import chicago_au_map

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def main() -> int:
    presets = json.loads((ROOT / "assets/factory_banks/chicago.json").read_text())["presets"]
    m = chicago_au_map.preset_from_factory_bank(presets, 0, arp_off=True)
    assert m["bass303"][5] == chicago_au_map._pot_from_byte(chicago_au_map._byte_from_au(0.24409449))
    assert m["chi"]["arp_switch"] == 0
    # Env ADSR dual-drives filter EG (FEnv ADSR) — Acid Lab 1.
    assert m["bass303"][15] == 1, m["bass303"][15]
    assert m["bass303"][12] == m["bass303"][19]
    assert m["bass303"][3] == m["bass303"][20]
    assert m["bass303"][13] == m["bass303"][21]
    assert m["bass303"][14] == m["bass303"][22]
    # Hot Tube / One Hit Wonder / The Visitor dump Amp Level 0 — floor to Init.
    init_vol = chicago_au_map._pot_from_byte(201, 127)
    for idx, name in ((33, "Hot Tube"), (47, "One Hit Wonder"), (71, "The Visitor")):
        assert presets[idx]["name"] == name
        assert chicago_au_map._byte_from_au(presets[idx]["params"][12]) == 0
        row = chicago_au_map.preset_from_factory_bank(presets, idx, arp_off=True)
        assert row["bass303"][7] == init_vol, (name, row["bass303"][7], init_vol)
        assert row["bass303"][15] == 1
    # Non-zero Amp Level still maps linearly (BearHug).
    bear = chicago_au_map.preset_from_factory_bank(presets, 5, arp_off=True)
    assert bear["bass303"][7] == chicago_au_map._pot_from_byte(
        chicago_au_map._byte_from_au(presets[5]["params"][12]), 127
    )
    # Alkaline Bass: Env mode + sustain — filter sustain mirrors amp.
    alkaline = chicago_au_map.preset_from_factory_bank(presets, 2, arp_off=True)
    assert presets[2]["name"] == "Alkaline Bass"
    assert alkaline["bass303"][16] == 0  # Amp Mode Env
    assert alkaline["bass303"][13] == alkaline["bass303"][21] > 0
    print("ok chicago_au_map")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Synthetic unit fixtures + exact existing complete package; no device operations."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tools/mboot'))
import prepare as p


def synthetic_snapshot(package, key=None):
    product, logical = p.add_ctl.logical_of(package)
    state = p.add_ctl._open(logical)
    image = bytearray(b'\xff' * p.FLASH)
    image[:len(state['flash'])] = state['flash']
    config = bytearray(p.pm.key_blob(state['key'] if key is None else key))
    for name, value in [('OSC', b'OSC0'), ('OSC_FREQ', struct.pack('<I', 24000000)),
                        ('SYS_CLK', struct.pack('<I', 360000000)),
                        ('HSB_DIV', struct.pack('<I', 1)), ('LSB_DIV', struct.pack('<I', 2))]:
        config += bytes([len(value)]) + name.encode() + b'\0' + value
    config += b'\0'
    image[64:96] = p.add_ctl._dec(p.pm.entry(p.pm.crc16(config), 0x38d0, len(config), 2, 0x80, 0, 'isd_config.ini'))
    image[32:64] = p.add_ctl._dec(p.pm.entry(0xffff, 0xa0, 0x3830, 0, 0, 0, 'uboot.boot'))
    image[0x38d0:0x38d0+len(config)] = config
    image[0xc1000:0xc1224] = b'\x53' * 0x224
    image[0xc1224:0xc122c] = b'trimdat\0'
    image[0xfff00:] = b'\xa7' * 256
    return bytes(image)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument('--package', required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--package-sha256', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--controller-sha256', required=True)
    ap.add_argument('--upstream', required=True, type=Path)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    raw = a.package.read_bytes(); p.pinned(raw, a.package_sha256, 'fixture package')
    up = a.upstream.resolve(); boot = (up / 'build/smk37/uboot.boot').read_bytes()
    image = synthetic_snapshot(raw)
    pins = dict(model='elite', snapshot_sha256=p.digest(image), package_sha256=a.package_sha256,
                container_sha256=p.digest(boot), controller_sha256=a.controller_sha256)
    head, updated, report = p.candidate(image, raw, boot, pins, up)
    assert report['application_controller_ota_unchanged'] and not report['device_access']
    assert head[:32] == image[:32] and head[64:0xa0] == image[64:0xa0]
    assert head[0x38d0:] == image[0x38d0:p.HEAD]
    old = p.add_ctl._open(p.add_ctl.logical_of(raw)[1])
    new = p.add_ctl._open(p.add_ctl.logical_of(updated)[1])
    assert old['flash'][p.HEAD:] == new['flash'][p.HEAD:]
    assert p.add_ctl.controller_of(p.add_ctl.logical_of(updated)[1]) == p.add_ctl.controller_of(p.add_ctl.logical_of(raw)[1])
    checks = 1
    def refused(call):
        nonlocal checks
        try:
            call()
        except (ValueError, p.add_ctl.PkgError):
            checks += 1
        else:
            raise AssertionError('unsafe input was accepted')
    for field in ('snapshot_sha256', 'package_sha256', 'container_sha256', 'controller_sha256'):
        bad = dict(pins); bad[field] = '0' * 64
        refused(lambda: p.candidate(image, raw, boot, bad, up))
    bad = dict(pins, model='pro'); refused(lambda: p.candidate(image, raw, boot, bad, up))
    bad_image = synthetic_snapshot(raw, old['key'] ^ 1)
    bad = dict(pins, snapshot_sha256=p.digest(bad_image))
    refused(lambda: p.candidate(bad_image, raw, boot, bad, up))
    for address, bank in ((0x8000, 0xffffffff), (0x4000, 0xc0000)):
        changed = bytearray(image)
        record = p.add_ctl._dec(changed[96:128])
        struct.pack_into('<II', record, 4, address, bank)
        struct.pack_into('<H', record, 0, p.pm.crc16(record[2:]))
        changed[96:128] = p.add_ctl._dec(record)
        bad = dict(pins, snapshot_sha256=p.digest(changed))
        refused(lambda: p.candidate(changed, raw, boot, bad, up))
    changed = bytearray(image)
    changed[128:160] = p.add_ctl._dec(p.pm.entry(0xffff, 0x8000, 0xc0000, 0x81, 0xff, 0, 'app_dir_head2'))
    bad = dict(pins, snapshot_sha256=p.digest(changed))
    refused(lambda: p.candidate(changed, raw, boot, bad, up))
    bare = p.add_ctl.add(raw, None); bad = dict(pins, package_sha256=p.digest(bare))
    refused(lambda: p.candidate(image, bare, boot, bad, up))
    malformed = bytearray(raw); malformed[2048] ^= 1
    bad = dict(pins, package_sha256=p.digest(malformed))
    refused(lambda: p.candidate(image, malformed, boot, bad, up))
    truncated = image[:-1]; bad = dict(pins, snapshot_sha256=p.digest(truncated))
    refused(lambda: p.candidate(truncated, raw, boot, bad, up))
    # Match actual unchanged installer behavior with a different reference head.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mboot-caller-test-') as directory:
        work = Path(directory)
        ref = work / 'head'; ref.write_bytes(head)
        logical = p.add_ctl.logical_of(updated)[1]
        assert p.fm1_install.head_compare(logical, ref)[0]
        broken = bytearray(head); broken[0xa0] ^= 1; ref.write_bytes(broken)
        assert not p.fm1_install.head_compare(logical, ref)[0]
        (work / 'snapshot').write_bytes(image); (work / 'pins.json').write_text(json.dumps(pins))
        command = [sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'tools/mboot/prepare.py'),
                   '--snapshot', str(work / 'snapshot'), '--pins', str(work / 'pins.json'),
                   '--package', str(a.package.resolve()), '--container', str(up / 'build/smk37/uboot.boot'),
                   '--upstream', str(up)]
        subprocess.run(command, check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        assert set(x.name for x in work.iterdir()) == {'head', 'snapshot', 'pins.json'}
        destination = work / 'private-candidate'
        subprocess.run(command + ['--candidate-dir', str(destination)], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        assert (destination / 'app-package.NOT-INSTALLABLE-candidate').read_bytes() == updated
        assert (destination / 'adoption-head.PRIVATE-candidate').read_bytes() == head
        assert destination.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o700
        for path in destination.iterdir():
            assert path.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600
        assert subprocess.run(command + ['--candidate-dir', str(destination)], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                              stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode != 0
        checks += 3
    assert p.digest(a.package.read_bytes()) == a.package_sha256
    print('PASS %d offline caller/package groups; original package unchanged; synthetic snapshot deleted' % checks)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
